news.title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
news.summary: Buterin wants Ethereum to do far more work without forcing every computer on the network to repeat the same calculations.

news.title: How months of work on the Clarity Act all fell apart
news.summary: Interviews with industry participants and legislative aides paint a picture of a blown bill-writing process, with sources pointing to nearly every facet of the bill's development and the debate around it as contributing factors to this month's failed vote.

news.title: Kraken’s parent Payward is betting billions on becoming financial infrastructure, not just a crypto exchange
news.summary: Kraken parent Payward is unifying trading, payments, asset management and institutional services on common rails, co-CEO Arjun Sethi said.

news.title: Binance deal gives Circle a boost in stablecoin race with Tether, analysts say
news.summary: The five-year deal could strengthen USDC’s reach in emerging markets, though Tether’s liquidity advantage remains hard to dislodge, analysts told CoinDesk.

news.title: Bitget hacker moves $83 million in stolen XRP that Ripple cannot freeze
news.summary: Two wallets have been almost emptied and a third is being drained, with about $75 million remaining across the five original holding accounts.

news.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
news.summary: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

news.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
news.summary: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

news.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
news.summary: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.

news.title: Social Security overpaid my 82-year-old mother by $20,000. What else is hiding in her finances?
news.summary: “My mother has a pension, Social Security, investments and a house probably worth over $1 million.”

news.title: My husband and I are in our 50s and have no kids. We have $2 million in IRAs and 401(k)s. Do we really need a will?
news.summary: “We have no debt and own our primary home, a vacation home, as well as my mother’s home in another state.”

news.title: ‘It doesn’t seem fair’: I’m retired and have plenty of money. Why can’t I qualify for a retail credit card?
news.summary: “I draw from my IRA as needed for household repairs, trips and other larger expenses.”

news.title: My friend is terminally ill. Should she sell her rental home and pay $100,000 in capital gains?
news.summary: “Her younger son lives in the condo, but wants to move elsewhere with friends.”

news.title: I’m 77, pay rent and live off Social Security, but I help homeless people. Why are so many people going hungry?
news.summary: “I am a retired senior citizen living check-to-check.”

news.title: ‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
news.summary: “As a country, we have grown dangerously comfortable.”

news.title: Micron could dethrone Nvidia and become the biggest driver of S&P 500 profit growth
news.summary: Micron is increasingly important to the S&P 500, and its earnings report has become “a market event in and of itself.”
